draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 207th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 25th of 37 at CB. He went 141st overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (207th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (16th percentile), broad jump (6th percentile). College production: 9 passes defended in 2021, 6th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2023. 15 career games and 0 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2023.
